Chapter 190 Land Use and Development

§ 190-30 Site plan review required.

No building permit shall be issued for any development requiring site plan approval unless the Planning Board has approved a site plan.

§ 190-31 Submission requirements; checklist.

Every application for site plan approval shall include the items set forth in the checklist in Schedule A attached to this chapter.

1. Key map at a scale of not less than 1" = 1,000'.

2. Boundary and topographic survey with contours at two-foot intervals.

3. Stormwater management report demonstrating compliance with N.J.A.C. 7:8.

§ 190-32 Waiver of submission requirements.

The Board may waive any checklist item upon a finding that the information is not necessary to make an informed decision. Items 1 through 5 of the general requirements shall not be waived. A request for a waiver shall be in writing and shall state the reasons therefor.

§ 190-45 Off-street parking requirements.

Retail uses shall provide one parking space for each 200 square feet of gross floor area. Electric vehicle make-ready spaces shall be provided per P.L. 2021, c.171.

§ 190-60 Buffers and landscaping.

A 50-foot landscaped buffer shall be provided where a nonresidential use abuts a residential zone.
